metadata.title: Improvement of the dimension bound for unweighted RCD spaces
metadata.abstract: We show that if $(X,d,\mathscr H^n)$ is an $RCD(K,N)$ space for some $K\in\mathbb{R}$ and $N\in [1,\infty)$, then it is also a (non-collapsed) $RCD(K,n)$ space. In other words, unweighted finite-dimensional $RCD$ spaces enjoy an automatic improvement of the dimension bound to the Hausdorff dimension of the space. More generally, we prove that this holds also when $N=\infty$, provided that we assume in addition the $n$-rectifiability of the space.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明以 $n$ 维 Hausdorff 测度为参考测度的 $RCD(K,N)$ 空间自动满足非塌缩 $RCD(K,n)$。
analysis.breakthrough: 把合成维数上界自动压缩到实际 Hausdorff 维；$N=\infty$ 时在 n-可整流假设下仍成立。
analysis.limitations: 无限维参数情形需要额外可整流性；摘要未展示局部到全局的关键论证。
